notes: v620 — INSTANT SELL, ADDED ALONGSIDE THE REALISTIC ONE. Selling used to only queue for the next trading day's open, by design, to keep the practice honest — so a sell could never quietly use a close you'd already seen. That protection stays exactly as it was. Now sitting right next to it: an instant option that records the sale immediately, at today's last snapshot, clearly labelled for what it is — not a live price, since this app has none, just today's already-known number, right now instead of tomorrow. Both choices, every time you sell, so you pick which one fits. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
